item.title: Consultancy services to produce a local (heritage-led) design code
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-22T23:59:59Z
The Council of the Isles of Scilly is seeking to commission a suitably qualified and experienced consultant or consultancy team to prepare a Local Design Code in accordance with the National Model Design Code (NMDC) and the Levelling Up and Regeneration Act 2023. The design code will support the emerging Local Plan and reflect the unique heritage, landscape, and built environment of the Isles.

item.title: Lift Maintenance at Science Museum Group
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 15,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-31T17:00:00+00:00
The Science Museum wishes to establish a contract for the provision of Lift Maintenance Services at its Science Mueum site in London and Science & Innovation Park in Wroughton. The scope includes Electric traction passenger, goods and goods/passenger lifts, Platform lifts and Escalators. The contract term will be 3 years with the option to extend by a further 2 years.
